findings.evidence: The changelog asserts the completed fact that `the local tag moved to the final release commit`, but the live repository says otherwise: HEAD is 91bfcc80786705d1920d6401776e25d3edd04366 and `git rev-parse v5.0.0^{commit}` is c5ba7cc4f687f822c8157f1ac44c8677d1208508. The final release commit does not yet exist because the reviewed changes are uncommitted. A disclosed intention to move and verify the tag after committing is sequencing intent, not evidence that the past-tense claim is currently true.
findings.description: Writing the completed state is not acceptable here. It is exactly the documented defect family: release prose currently reports a mechanism as completed when it has not run. State the enforceable publication invariant instead—for example, that publication is gated on the local tag resolving to the final release commit—and perform and verify the move after that commit exists.
